title: GitHub Actions release failed updating a protected Git tag
summary: The tt-metal release workflow failed because GitHub rejected an operation on a protected Git ref. The exact tag and SHA conflict remain unconfirmed.
recommendation: Inspect the full job log and identify the actual tag and commit SHAs. Do not automatically force-move a protected release tag. If a tag points to a different commit, stop with a clear diagnostic and determine whether a new version tag is appropriate.
root_cause: Unconfirmed hypothesis: the release workflow may have attempted to update an existing protected Git tag to a different commit.

fix.description: Detect a tag-to-SHA mismatch and stop the release instead of automatically moving a protected tag.
